settings.text: Free UK delivery on every order. Orders are processed within 1–3 working days and sent tracked; you'll get a tracking link by email. UK delivery usually takes 3–14 days depending on the item, because some products ship directly from our fulfilment partners. See our Shipping Policy.
Not right for you? Email info@bioluxelab.com within 30 days of delivery and we'll send return instructions. Damaged or faulty items are replaced or refunded. See Delivery & Returns.
We're a UK-based team. Use the chat button, email info@bioluxelab.com or visit our contact page.
